notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth and Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger.
Resolve the Herd Baloth trigger, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Moss-Pit Skeleton trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Beast token, causing you to mill Moss-Pit Skeleton and three other cards from the top of your library.
The Wise Mothman's second ability triggers at least once, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth, and any other desired creature(s) if applicable.
Repeat from step 2.
